research_gaps: Falmouth guidebook excerpt (page 105; Contents-page statement) came back through a summarizing fetch tool of the lead session: a careful copy, not byte-exact. The PDF is 152 pages and was not opened directly by the fact-checker.
Mashpee directory card for FabVilla was read live with the Shopping & Specialty Retail filter ticked; the chamber's phone number differs from the shop's own and is not published here.
Provincetown Fudge Factory: the post's hours text is on a graphic; the lines are those the fact-checker recorded from the Nov 1 post.
Cabot's Candy Factory and Chatham Candy Manor: no hours found on the pages read.
Cape Cod Museum of Natural History: the shop's own hours and description were not found; the hours given are the museum's.
DRIFT Wellfleet: driftwellfleet.com did not load for the fact-checker; the address and hours are from its Instagram profile.
Snow's Home & Garden: snowscapecod.com did not load for the fact-checker; the address and description are from its Instagram profile.
Atlantic Spice Company, Nauset Lantern Shop, Bass River Mercantile: undated website text only; no social proof found.
Several 'site description says' quotes were found in the page meta description, not visible text.
By-the-Bay Designs, Wellfleet Marine Retail Store, Celebrations of Cape Cod: Facebook post ages are relative as shown on the check day, not stored timestamps.
Truro Vineyards: no on-site gift shop described on the pages read.
